title: forestiera pubescens subsp. neomexicana
intro: Forestiera pubescens subsp. neomexicana, commonly known as Desert Privet, is a shrub native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, as well as potential treatment for conditions such as fever, colds, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Desert Privet are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Forestiera pubescens subsp. neomexicana include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic effects.
